result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the fixed bottom navigation is visibly broken and obscures content near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The bottom navigation is positioned too low, causing its icons to be clipped by the viewport edge and crossed by the device home indicator.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device safe-area inset and add sufficient bottom padding so the navigation icons sit fully above the home indicator.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the restaurant feed, hiding the title and details associated with the second card.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation height plus the safe-area inset so all card content can scroll above the navigation.
